geometry_probe.interpretation: The model root's local X is vertical. Its old local-XY projection understated the ground footprint. The corrected bound uses the full three-dimensional corner norm, conservative under arbitrary rigid base tilt. The planned radius increases; safety gates are not relaxed.

saved_telemetry_frame_check.interpretation: Saved measured displacement agrees with local-Z-forward/local-Y-lateral native axes. Treating gamma alone as planar heading predicts the wrong X direction. Rounded velocities are diagnostic, not acceptance tolerances.

compatibility: Robot measured_pose.rotation_rpy_degrees retains historical raw Coppelia alpha-beta-gamma measurements; it is not generic yaw-pitch-roll. The existing public yaw-only helper remains available, but live native controls use the explicit ABG projection.
required_next_evidence: Fresh clean-source nominal and unavailable-robot full-cottage runs with all original completion, replay, measured-motion, collision, pose-write, and clearance gates.
